rows.name: Georgius Uroda
rows.relation: father of ahnentafel 54
rows.citation: Umrli 1774-1804 fol. 67 - "Dnus Georgius Uroda ... die 12a sepultus est in propria [sua Crypta ante] fores Ecclesiae Parochialis"; DGS 5481649

rows.name: Maria Uroda
rows.relation: wife of Georgius, mother of ahnentafel 54
rows.citation: Rodjeni 1771-1804 fol. 36/37 - "ex Georgio, et Maria Uroda, Conjugibus, hujus Loci"; ark 3:1:3QSQ-G99C-L991-3

rows.name: Dominicus Uroda
rows.relation: brother of ahnentafel 54
rows.citation: Karlobag births, indexed; father Georgius, mother Maria

rows.name: Petrus Jacobus Uroda
rows.relation: brother of ahnentafel 54
rows.citation: Karlobag births, indexed; buried 7 November per the 1774-1804 death index fol. 82

rows.name: Heva Joanna Uroda
rows.relation: sister of ahnentafel 54
rows.citation: Karlobag births, indexed; buried 11 May per the 1774-1804 death index fol. 5

rows.name: Maria Catharina Uroda
rows.relation: sister of ahnentafel 54
rows.citation: Karlobag births, indexed; father Georgius, mother Maria

rows.name: Anton Joanis Uroda
rows.relation: brother of ahnentafel 54
rows.citation: Karlobag births, indexed; father Georgius, mother Maria

rows.name: Joannis Uroda
rows.relation: brother of ahnentafel 54; married Maria filia Nicolai Barletich 10 Feb 1806
rows.citation: Karlobag births, indexed; his wife stands godmother to ahnentafel 27 in 1810

rows.name: Maria Rosaria Antic
rows.relation: daughter of ahnentafel 24 and 25, sister of ahnentafel 12
rows.citation: Selce baptisms, indexed - father Josephus Antic, mother Maria Jellicic; ark 3:1:3QS7-899C-596Z-7

rows.name: Stephanus Zubrinic
rows.relation: son of ahnentafel 10 and 11, brother of ahnentafel 5
rows.citation: Otocac baptisms entry 49 - "Rustici Confiniarii e Sumecica N. 2 ... Nicolaus Zubrinic et ejus uxor Anna nata Strumbulko"; ark 3:1:3QSQ-G99C-PK2C

rows.name: Maria Magdalena Theresia Žubrinić
rows.relation: daughter of Michaël Žubrinić and Maria Marković, Otočac
rows.citation: Rodjeni 1846-1858 - Conditio «Agricola Confiniarius», no village or house number given; ark 3:1:3QS7-899C-G5D9

rows.name: Mathias Žubrinić
rows.relation: son of Michael Žubrinić and Maria Marković, Šumećica N° 5
rows.citation: Rodjeni 1846-1858 - «Confiniarius e Sumećica N° 5», first entry of 1855 below the year rule; ark 3:1:3QS7-899C-PVT8

rows.name: Josephus Žubrinić
rows.relation: son of Michael Žubrinić and Maria Rogić, Prozor N° 50
rows.citation: Rodjeni 1846-1858 - «Miles Gregarius e Prozor N° 50»; brother of Nikola Miko b. 8 Jan 1858, who is in the tree; ark 3:1:3QSQ-G99C-PK64

rows.name: Stephanus Žubrinić
rows.relation: son of Michael Žubrinić and Maria Marković, Šumećica N° 5
rows.citation: Rodjeni 1846-1858 p. 290 - «Rusticus e Sumećica N° 5»; brother of Marta 1849 and Magdalena 1852, who are in the tree; ark 3:1:3QS7-899C-PVGY

rows.name: Maria Žubrinić
rows.relation: daughter of Michael Žubrinić and Magdalena Glavinić, Prozor N° 49
rows.citation: Rodjeni 1846-1858 - «Rustica e Prozor N° 49»; surname written Žubrinić on the page where the index reads «Dubrinić»; ark 3:1:3QS7-899C-PVLN

rows.name: Mare Antić
rows.relation: daughter of Josip (ahnentafel 24) and Maria Antić, Selce N° 74; sister of ahnentafel 12
rows.citation: LIBER DEFUNCTORUM p. 99 - «Preminu Osip Antić težak i Mare kćer», aged 6, «Od kolere», father and daughter in one entry; ark 3:1:3QSQ-G99X-13PY

rows.name: Matilda Papić
rows.relation: third name on the stone cross of Josip Papić (ahnentafel 6) and Antonija — almost certainly their daughter
rows.citation: Senj municipal cemetery, «MATILDA ✽1895 †1921», read at 4x. NOT IN THE TREE UNDER THIS NAME: the tree has two Papić daughters born 1895 — Franka (20 Jan) and Sulka (7 Feb) — and neither has a death recorded. One of them may be this woman; IMG_8131

rows.name: Antonius Gergacs
rows.relation: son of Nicolaus Gerkacs (ahnentafel 220), and therefore a brother of ahnentafel 110
rows.event: named in his father's death entry
rows.citation: Karlobag Umrli 1774-1804 folio 39 — his father «obiit … in domo filij sui Antonij», died in this son's house. Not in the published tree; the Gerkacs collaterals are not published at all; ark 3:1:3QS7-L99C-GSBH

rows.name: Margaritha Smojver
rows.relation: daughter of ahnentafel 212 and 213
rows.citation: Karlobag births, indexed, entry 270 — «Entry for Margaritham Smoiver and Josephi Smoiver»; mother Antoniae. ark 1:1:QKMX-YLY7. Born twelve years after her parents' marriage of 20 Nov 1752 and twelve years before her father's death in 1776

rows.name: Joseip Pekasu
rows.relation: son of Šimun Pekas of Karlobag; candidate brother of ahnentafel 213
rows.citation: Karlobag births, indexed — «Parents Šimun Pekasu». The earliest Pekas entry found; his own daughter Antonia is baptised 1742

rows.name: Margarita Pekasa
rows.relation: daughter of Šimun Pekas of Karlobag; candidate sister of ahnentafel 213
rows.citation: Karlobag births, indexed — «Parents Simon Pekasa», no mother named

rows.name: Katarina Pekasa
rows.relation: daughter of Šimun Pekas and STOJA; candidate half-sister of ahnentafel 213
rows.citation: Karlobag births, indexed — «Parents Stoja, Simuna Pekasa». The mother is NOT Mare

rows.name: Perina Pekasa
rows.relation: daughter of Šimun Pekas and MARE; candidate sister of ahnentafel 213
rows.citation: Karlobag births, indexed — «Parents Simuna Pekasa, Mare». Mare is the only wife named that matches ahnentafel 427, Mara Pekass

rows.name: Antonia Pehasa
rows.relation: daughter of Osip Pekas and Monde, Karlobag — explicitly NOT ahnentafel 213
rows.citation: Karlobag births, indexed — «Parents Monde, Osipa Pehasa». Recorded here to rule her out: ahnentafel 213 married in 1752 and bore a son in 1754, so a girl baptised 1742 cannot be her

rows.name: Antonü Bechi (Bacchi)
rows.relation: second son of ahnentafel 428 and 429, and not in the tree
rows.citation: Karlobag births, indexed — «Angelo Bechi × Catharina», ark 1:1:QKMX-B9R1. A brother of ahnentafel 214, born twenty months after him under the same two parents

rows.name: Hevam Uroda
rows.relation: daughter of ahnentafel 108 and 109, and not in the tree
rows.citation: Karlobag births, indexed — «Georgio Uroda × Maria». THE SECOND OF THAT NAME: Heva Joanna was baptised to the same couple on 28 December 1769, so either the first died and the name was reused, or the index holds one child twice

rows.name: Mikola Luckinicha
rows.relation: son of a Vicko Luckinić of Karlobag; CANDIDATE elder brother of ahnentafel 105
rows.citation: Karlobag births, indexed — «Parents Vicka Luckinicha», no mother named; ark 1:1:QKMX-YTMT

rows.name: Mare Luckinicha
rows.relation: daughter of a Vicko Luckinić of Karlobag; CANDIDATE elder sister of ahnentafel 105
rows.citation: Karlobag births, indexed — «Parents Vicka Luckinicha», no mother named; ark 1:1:QKMX-YVND. Two years before ahnentafel 105 was born in the same parish to a father of the same name

rows.name: Magdalenam Gergacs
rows.relation: daughter of ahnentafel 110 and 111, and not in the tree
rows.citation: Karlobag births, indexed — «Michaële Gergacs × Lucia»; ark 1:1:QKMX-BCZC

rows.name: Magdalenam Gargacs
rows.relation: SECOND daughter of that name to ahnentafel 110 and 111 — a necronym, or the index holding one child twice
rows.citation: Karlobag births, indexed — «Michaele Gargacs × Lucia»; ark 1:1:QKMX-Y1CM. The first Magdalena was baptised 11 March 1787

rows.name: Catharinam Gergacz
rows.relation: daughter of ahnentafel 110 and 111, and not in the tree
rows.citation: Karlobag births, indexed — «Michaële Gergacz × Luciæ»; ark 1:1:QKMX-YVGM

rows.name: Bartholomæum Gergacs
rows.relation: son of ahnentafel 110 and 111, and not in the tree
rows.citation: Karlobag births, indexed — «Michaelo Gergacs × Luciæ»; ark 1:1:QKMX-YBDF

rows.name: Mathiam Gergacs
rows.relation: son of ahnentafel 110 and 111, and not in the tree
rows.citation: Karlobag births, indexed — «Michaële Gergacs × Lucia»; ark 1:1:QKMX-YK1J

rows.name: Mariæ Vukich
rows.relation: daughter of ahnentafel 106 and 107, indexed under their BY-NAME
rows.citation: Karlobag births, indexed — «Vincentio Vukich × Oliva»; ark 1:1:QKMX-YF7B. The 1781 reading of their daughter Oliva gives them as «Vincentio, et Oliva Smoyver, VULGÒ VUKIĆ, Conjugibus», so Vukich is this couple's recorded house name

rows.name: Josephi Francisci Vukich
rows.relation: son of ahnentafel 106 and 107, indexed under their BY-NAME
rows.citation: Karlobag births, indexed — «Vincentio Vukich × Oliva»; ark 1:1:QKMX-YFJS

rows.name: Anna Oliva Vukics
rows.relation: daughter of ahnentafel 106 and 107, indexed under their BY-NAME
rows.citation: Karlobag births, indexed — «Vincentio Vukics × Oliva»; ark 1:1:QKMX-B3LJ

rows.name: Smojuer (no given name in the index)
rows.relation: child of ahnentafel 106 and 107, and not in the tree
rows.citation: Karlobag births, indexed — «Vincentio Smojuer × Oliva»; ark 1:1:QKMX-BCN6. The index carries no given name for this child

rows.name: Vincentiam Luciam Smoÿver
rows.relation: daughter of ahnentafel 106 and 107, and not in the tree
rows.citation: Karlobag births, indexed — «Vincentio Smoÿver × Oliva»; ark 1:1:QKMX-YJ2M

rows.name: Michael Sekula
rows.relation: son of ahnentafel 42 and 43, and not in the tree
rows.citation: Otočac births, indexed — «Marcus Sekula × Lucia»; ark 1:1:QKMK-SKPG. The couple is indexed under BOTH surnames, and the tree itself carries two of their children as «Orešković Oreskovic Sekula»

rows.name: Paulus Sekula
rows.relation: son of ahnentafel 42 and 43, and not in the tree — TWIN of Petrus
rows.citation: Otočac births, indexed — «Marcus Sekula × Lucia»; ark 1:1:QKMK-SQML. Petrus, whom the tree has, was baptised the SAME DAY to the same parents: ark 1:1:QKMK-SQMV. Twins, not a duplicate

rows.name: Mariam Catharinam Pilipich
rows.relation: daughter of ahnentafel 26 and 27, and not in the tree
rows.citation: Karlobag births, indexed — «Vincentü Pilipich × Matthææ Urade»; ark 1:1:QKMX-BJJT. Four years before ahnentafel 13

rows.name: Georgium Pilipich
rows.relation: son of ahnentafel 26 and 27, and not in the tree
rows.citation: Karlobag births, indexed — «Vincentü Pilipich × Mathiæ Uroda»; ark 1:1:QKMX-BQD8

rows.name: Georgius Perpić
rows.relation: son of ahnentafel 14 and 15; CANDIDATE younger brother of ahnentafel 7
rows.citation: Krivi Put births, indexed — «Joannes Perpić × Lucia Perpić»; ark 1:1:XQM9-ZVQK. A CANDIDATE: Prpić is the dominant surname of this parish and the index holds several Perpić × Perpić couples. What supports it is that the same couple's Stephanus of 1861 IS in the tree

rows.name: Joanna Perpić
rows.relation: daughter of ahnentafel 14 and 15; CANDIDATE younger sister of ahnentafel 7
rows.citation: Krivi Put births, indexed — born 6 Jan 1874, «Joannes Perpić × Lucia Perpić»; ark 1:1:XQM9-XB9Q. Same caution as Georgius

rows.name: Josephus Perpić
rows.relation: son of ahnentafel 14 and 15; CANDIDATE younger brother of ahnentafel 7
rows.citation: Krivi Put births, indexed — «Joannes Perpić × Lucia»; ark 1:1:XQM9-J5PG. Same caution, and the mother is given only as Lucia

rows.name: Dominicum Bartholomæum Uroda
rows.relation: son of ahnentafel 54 and 55, and not in the tree — brother of ahnentafel 27
rows.citation: Karlobag births, indexed — «Georgio Uroda × Maria»; ark 1:1:QKMX-YGZF. Ahnentafel 54 was baptised «Joannis Georgij» and is named alive in 1834 as «piscatoris GEORGII Uroda», so the index's Georgius is him. Two years after ahnentafel 27, to the same couple

rows.name: Margaritha Maria Uroda
rows.relation: daughter of ahnentafel 54's BROTHER Joannis, not of ahnentafel 54
rows.citation: Karlobag births, indexed — «Joanne Uroda × Maria»; ark 1:1:QKMX-YG4K. She CANNOT be ahnentafel 55's: ahnentafel 27 was born to her on 23 April 1810, nine weeks later. The father is the brother baptised 1784, who married Maria filia Nicolai Barletich on 10 February 1806

rows.name: Joannem Bartholomæum Stanislaum Uroda
rows.relation: son of ahnentafel 54's BROTHER Joannis
rows.citation: Karlobag births, indexed — «Joanne Uroda × Maria»; ark 1:1:QKMX-BV6R. Same household as Margaritha of 1810 — the brother's, not ahnentafel 54's

rows.name: Hevam Vuhich
rows.relation: daughter of ahnentafel 212 and 213, indexed under their BY-NAME; CANDIDATE
rows.citation: Karlobag births, indexed — «Josephi Vuhich × Antoniæ»; ark 1:1:QKMX-YYFL. Ahnentafel 212's death entry of 1776 is «Josephus Smojver dictus VUKCICH», so Vukić is this man's recorded house name

rows.name: Joannæ Vukich
rows.relation: daughter of ahnentafel 212 and 213, indexed under their BY-NAME; CANDIDATE
rows.citation: Karlobag births, indexed — «Josepho Vukich × Antonia»; ark 1:1:QKMX-BZ42

rows.name: Simonem Pillopich
rows.relation: brother of ahnentafel 52, son of ahnentafel 104 and 105
rows.citation: Karlobag births, indexed — «Jacobi Pillopich × Catharina»; ark 1:1:QKMX-YDW1

rows.name: Franciscum Pillepich
rows.relation: brother of ahnentafel 52, son of ahnentafel 104 and 105
rows.citation: Karlobag births, indexed — «Jacobi Pillepich × Catharinæ»; ark 1:1:QKMX-BSB4

rows.name: Simolicianum Pillepich
rows.relation: brother of ahnentafel 52, son of ahnentafel 104 and 105
rows.citation: Karlobag births, indexed — «Jacobi Pillepich × Catharinæ»; ark 1:1:QKMX-BMMQ
